discussions.title: Eric’s reasons why antennas and receivers suck

posts.author: Eric
posts.text: Attenaes and receivers should not be added because these items defeat the purpose of redstone. Redstone is supposed to encourage creativity via having the player perform advanced problem solving, but block that are too “advanced” like these would cause redstoners to become lazier. On the surface, these blocks may sound like a way to make life easier, but they really just phase out creative methods of remote powering such as bud switching or calibrated sculk sensors. Another reason why attenaes and receivers suck is because the advanced technological feeling given by these blocks do not fit the medieval voxel survival game vibe in minecraft.

posts.author: Sai
posts.text:
Aluminum Should be added because the player could make drones (Redstone), planes, flexible wires, & The player could strengthen steel with it.
Titanium Should be removed because it can only be used to strengthen steel (Aluminum can already do that)

posts.author: Eric
posts.text: Aluminum should not be added into Minecraft because many things aluminum can do can be already accomplished with iron, and since weight is not a thing, they are basically the same. Drones and airplanes don’t fit the feel of “nothing making sense (floating blocks, etc.)” feel of fantasy/medieval games, not futuristic modern games. Bendable wires are Redstone dust, so there is no need for electricity in the game, too realistic too). Aluminum if added would be the other version of copper ore before Mojang gave it more uses, and the developers would say “oh its useful”, but in real gameplay, not be needed.

More lotta lotta stuff for fishing:
Hook:
0=nothing, 1=iron nugget 2=tripwire hook
0, 1, 0
1, 2, 1
0, 0, 0
Hooks can be used to make baits
Baits:
0=nothing 1=hook 2=otherstuff
0, 1, 0
2, 2, 2
2, 2, 2
The player can use fishing rods without anything, but they will get stuff at 35% the rate and get pretty bad stuff. Normal hooks will get stuff at 75% the rate and give slightly worse stuff than vanilla minecraft fishing drops
The way hooks and bait can be used while fishing is by holding them in your offhand. Hooks and baits can also be enchanted with the following enchantments:
Luck of the sea I, II, and III effect: major luck bonus: increases rarity of fished items/fish
Not sure how it works yet so no stats yet
Luring I, II, and III effect: increases chance of getting fish +minor luck bonus at III
I=+15% II=+30% III=+45% on hook
Magnetization I, II, and III effect: increases chance of getting gear and sometimes ores +minor luck bonus at III
I=+15% II=+25% III=+35% on hook
Enchanting I, II, and III effect: increases chance of getting enchanted books +minor luck bonus at III
I=+5% II=+10% III=+15% on hook
Repelling I, II, and III effect: lower chance of getting fish +minor luck bonus at III
I=+20% II=+30% III=+40% on hook
Enhancement I, II, and III effect: fish items faster
I=+20% II=+35% III=+50% on hook
minor luck bonus gives +50% of luck of the sea I bonus
If both enchanting and magnetization activate then you will get enchanted gear. Higher luck = better enchant.
Cannot have:
Luring + repelling
Luring + magnetization
Luring + enchanting
Now for the rod enchants. Something to note is that normal rod enchants will have levels I, II, and III. But magic rods(maybe gonna be a thing) will also have enchants IV and V.
These are the rod enchants (same as hook ones but better stats):
Luck of the sea I, II, III, IV and V effect: major luck bonus: increases rarity of fished items/fish
Not sure how it works yet so no stats yet
Luring I, II, III, IV and V effect: increases chance of getting fish +minor luck bonus at III
I=+20% II=+40% III=+60% IV=+80% V=100% on rod
Magnetization I, II, III, IV and V effect: increases chance of getting gear and sometimes ores +minor luck bonus at III
I=+20% II=+35% III=+50% IV=+65% V=+85% on rod
Enchanting I, II, III, IV and V effect: increases chance of getting enchanted books +minor luck bonus at III
I=+10% II=+15% III=+20% IV=+30% V=+40% on rod
Repelling I, II, III, IV and V effect: lower chance of getting fish +minor luck bonus at III
I=+20% II=+40% III=+60% IV=+80% V=100% on rod
Enhancement I, II, III, IV and V effect: fish items faster
I=+25% II=+50% III=+75% IV=+100% V=+125% on rod
minor luck bonus gives +75% of luck of the sea I bonus
If both enchanting and magnetization activate then you will get enchanted gear. Higher luck = better enchant.
Cannot have:
Luring + repelling
Luring + magnetization
Luring + enchanting
We need magic rods because that's a yes idea. Idk how we would get them either from something in strawberry minecraft or the sift. Magic rods are better than normal rods in pretty much every way and can have up to level V enchants unlike normal rods which have a max enchant level of III.
Alchemy table
WE NEED TO ADD AN ALCHEMY TABLE PLSSSSSSSSSSSSSS
(this is for normal AND parabola btw)
Alchemy table is an upgraded version of the brewing stand. It can only brew one potion at a time. The alchemy table has one potion slot, one fuel slot, and 2 ingredient slots. The alchemy table can also make some unique and power 3 potions.
Alchemy table:
0, 5, 1     0=nothing 1=glass bottle 2=dragons breath
1, 3, 2     3=glass block 4=blaze rod 5=brewing stand
0, 4, 0

Holy Cheese and lots of other stuff:
Holy cheese is a late to very late game item and is obtained my killing the holy cow miniboss. the holy cow mini boss is a very massive cow that is flying has a halo over its head and is also spinning very, very fast. The holy cow is always moving towards the player 3 blocks a second, 5 after you beat it once and has its own attacks that t has. Attack 1 is a dash. It dashes towards the player 15 blocks. Whenever the holy cow touches the player it inflicts 20 damage, 35 after you have beat it once. Its second attack if spraying helly milk at the player. this gives the player nausea, poison, lethal poison, and decay for 5 seconds, 12 seconds after the player has beaten it once. The holy cow boss drops holy milk. taking the holy milk it drops into an Australia or moonstone cauldron idk and then crafting the holy cheese using 6 holy cheese curds. (using cauldron gives you 6) holy cheese is some of the best things in the game and can be used to make holy cheese swords, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, armor, liver, vestilacheese, and other stuff. Other uses for the holy milk while its in the cauldron are making helly cheese. Helly cheese looks like holy cheese but with its main color being blood red. Eating helly cheese gives you nausea forever, blindness for 20 mins, lethal poison, decay, and normal poison for 40 mins. To actually make helly cheese you need to put holy milk into a molten cauldron and then drop a lava orb (wind charge surrounded by lava bucket) into the holy milk making it helly milk turning into helly cheese curds where you can then craft helly cheese with 6 helly cheese curds (it drops only 4) helly cheese is mostly used to get negative modifiers which you need to battle the foot miniboss (not created yet btw). To get the negative modifiers you need to get the alchemy lab (not made yet but should be an advanced version of the brewing stand in parabola mode and in normal) and infused with specific ingredient to make potions that give different modifiers when you drink them like player takes 2x damage for example except the description will not be direct to what it actually does (also if your reading this pls make a table for modifiers with section of ingredient (1) and the modifier given when you'd rank the potion) once you get all of the modifiers you have to craft a block of block of helly cheese by making a block of helly cheese  (helly cheese in all craft slots) then make the block of block of helly cheese (block of helly cheese in all craft slots) the player has to make a hellen't cheese potion using the alchemy table using the block of block of helly cheese and use the grindstoneone on the hellen't cheese potion and then it summons the foot mini-boss. The foot mini-bosses attacks, including: smashing: it smashes down and attacks the floor. If you are in a 7x7 are of the smash in all direction including y-axis then you take 72 damage. Its second attack is toenail fungus gas: it makes a 10x10 block radius around it where if you are standing in it you will get fatal poison, decay, darkness, nausea, and normal poison all for 5 secs refreshed every tick in the gas cloud. The gas smoke lasts 12 secs. The third attack is it attacks every 7 seconds and can't do any of its attacks 4 times in a row. Once you beat the foot you get something.(idk wat yet)
